subject.title: feat: add publisher feed model API

question: Should ClawHub adopt this unsigned publisher-feed API and its persisted snapshot/cursor contract as a supported public interface?
rationale: This is a new public API and durable data-model surface with related RFC work; tests can establish mechanics but cannot determine whether maintainers want to own this contract.

options.title: Sponsor the publisher-feed contract
options.body: Accept the publisher-only discovery API direction, contingent on redacted runtime proof and normal merge review.

options.title: Pause pending RFC alignment
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer merging until the RFC and dependent publisher-feed distribution work establish the desired long-term contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the publisher-feed contract
recommendation.body: Accept the publisher-only discovery API direction, contingent on redacted runtime proof and normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied review history shows direct technical review of the feature’s identity, visibility, and pagination contract.
